description: From the mainland path at night, the islet of Gaztelugatxe rises from the dark sea, its little hermitage moonlit atop the rock. The stone footbridge arches across the water to it, pale in the moonlight. Waves move black below the bridge; the hermitage sits tiny and luminous on its pinnacle under the stars.

prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Photorealistic artistic interpretation of San Juan de Gaztelugatxe, Basque Country, Spain, in deep night. IMPORTANT: there is no night lighting on the trail — an honest dark moonlit treatment, everything in deep shadow. The small hermitage on the rocky islet a dark silhouette under moonlight and a starry sky; the stone footbridge a dark curve over black water; moonlit waves in the Bay of Biscay faintly visible; the scene mostly dark and moody. No invented floodlighting. No identifiable people. Subject centred so it survives a 4:5 centre crop. No text or brand logos anywhere, no on-image text at all.
